# How do you post a truck on Amazon Relay?

URL: https://nudoiq.com/amazon-relay-post-a-truck/
Published: 2026-10-08. Last updated: 2026-10-08.

Short answer: To post a truck on Amazon Relay, create a Post A Truck order with your availability (up to two weeks ahead), a pickup radius and maximum deadhead, cities to include or exclude, one-way or round trip, distance or trip length limits, maximum stops, stem time and your minimum rate per mile. Relay matches loads to the order and books them for you. The order stays open until it matches or your availability window ends.

## What is Post A Truck on Amazon Relay?

Post A Truck is the opposite of searching the board. You post your equipment and driver availability, set the least you'll take, and Relay brings matching loads to you. [Amazon's Post A Truck guide](https://relay.amazon.com/blog/how-to-load-match-with-post-a-truck) says matched carriers get first access to freight in their window, before it reaches the load board.

Amazon also says it will [instantly book loads that match your criteria](https://relay.amazon.com/blog/intro-to-amazon-relay/how-to-find-truck-loads-faster-with-amazon-relays-free-freight-search), so you don't have to watch the board. That's the upside and the risk in one sentence: whatever matches is yours to run.

## Who can use Post A Truck?

Amazon says approved Relay carriers can access it. Beyond that:

- **Equipment.** [Amazon lists](https://relay.amazon.com/blog/booking-options/3-ways-to-set-your-own-freight-rates-on-amazon-relay) power only loads, box trucks (dock height and liftgate required) and live loads using your own tractor-trailer.
- **Grades.** Every grade keeps Post A Truck. Higher grades get priority matching. Our [scorecard guide](https://nudoiq.com/amazon-relay-scorecard/) explains how grades work.
- **Account.** You need an approved carrier account first. See the [Amazon Relay requirements checklist](https://nudoiq.com/amazon-relay-requirements/).

## How do you post a truck on Amazon Relay, step by step?

Amazon's guides describe what goes into an order rather than a screen-by-screen path. These are the choices an order asks you to make, in a sensible order to work through them.

1. **Pick how you start.** From scratch, from recommendations, or from a saved search (see the next section).
2. **Set your availability.** The days and hours your truck and driver are free, up to two weeks in advance.
3. **Set where the first pickup can be.** A radius for first pickup and a maximum deadhead.
4. **Choose destinations.** Include or exclude cities, and add preferred destinations.
5. **Pick one-way or round trip.** A round trip brings you back. A one-way needs a box truck or your own trailer.
6. **Set distance or trip duration limits** so a match fits your driver's day.
7. **Set maximum stops and stem time.**
8. **Set your price.** Your minimum rate per mile and a payout amount.
9. **Check the match outlook**, adjust if it's Low, and post the order.

You can create several orders for different trucks and lanes, and edit or cancel them any time.

## What are the three ways to start an order?

| Way to start | How it works |
|---|---|
| From scratch | You fill in every setting yourself |
| From recommendations | You enter a few settings and Relay fills the rest from your previous bookings |
| From a saved search | A search you saved on the board becomes the template |

If you already have a saved search for your home lane, starting from it is the fastest way to post.

## What do High, Medium and Low match outlook mean?

Match outlook is Relay's estimate of how likely your order is to match. It's based on your criteria and the previous 6 weeks of loads.

| Outlook | What Amazon says | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| High | Good chance of a match | Post it |
| Medium | Decent chance, room to improve | Loosen one setting if timing matters |
| Low | Adjust radius, distance, destination or price | Change one of those and check again |

Amazon says matching also uses market rates and Relay performance scores. Narrow criteria give fewer matches, and flexibility on routes or timing can help. So price isn't the only lever: Amazon lists radius, distance and destination right next to it.

## What are linked orders and block orders?

They solve two different problems.

- **Linked orders** connect several orders as one fulfilled order, so you don't overbook the same truck. Once one is fulfilled, the unfulfilled trips are cancelled for you.
- **Block orders** have trips that start and end at the same location. A matched block is paid in full even if Amazon doesn't use the entire block length. Blocks are explained in our guide to [Amazon Relay contracts and blocks](https://nudoiq.com/amazon-relay-contracts/).

If you post one truck on several lanes at once, linked orders are the setting that keeps you from matching twice.

## What happens when your order matches?

An order stays open until it matches or your availability window expires. Amazon's general rule for booked loads is plain. In [Amazon's words](https://relay.amazon.com/blog/amazon-relay-performance-score), "if an Amazon load is booked, it's the Relay carrier's responsibility to execute it."

Rejecting a booked load counts against your acceptance metric, and the closer to pickup, the higher the penalty. Our guide on [what happens if you cancel a load](https://nudoiq.com/amazon-relay-cancel-load/) covers it.

## How do you cancel a Post A Truck order?

Amazon says you can cancel an order if your availability changes, and edit or cancel orders any time. Do it as soon as plans change. An open order with the wrong hours can match a load your driver can't run, and then you're cancelling a booked load instead of an order.

If you're using Post A Truck to chain work after a delivery, our guide to [booking multiple loads on Amazon Relay](https://nudoiq.com/how-to-book-multiple-loads-on-amazon-relay/) walks through the hours math first.

## How does NudoIQ's One-Click Post A Truck work?

NudoIQ is a Chrome extension that runs inside your signed-in Relay load board tab. It's an independent tool, not made by or affiliated with Amazon. It adds a row of buttons under each load card, and the third one opens One-Click Post A Truck.

The panel shows that load's origin, destination, distance and board price next to your minimum rate per mile and minimum payout. Above the price field sits a recommended bid, based on what that lane has paid before.

Be clear on one thing: the recommended bid is not accurate right after install. It needs time gathering data about your area, and it improves with use. Treat it as a starting point and set your own price.

When the price is right, click Post Truck Now and an order is created for that load automatically. You skip building the order from a blank form.

NudoIQ is used by 300+ carriers. Try it with a 7-day free trial, and cancel anytime. It's rated 5.0 on the Chrome Web Store.

## Frequently asked questions

### How far ahead can you post a truck on Amazon Relay?
Up to two weeks ahead. The order stays open until it matches or your availability window expires.

### Can box trucks use Post A Truck on Amazon Relay?
Yes. Amazon lists box trucks as eligible, as long as the truck is dock height with a liftgate. Power only loads and live loads with your own tractor-trailer are eligible too.

### Why is my Post A Truck match outlook low?
Low means your criteria don't line up well with the loads Relay saw in the previous 6 weeks. Amazon suggests adjusting your radius, distance, destination or price. More flexibility on routes or timing can help.

### Does Post A Truck guarantee a load?
No. Your order only books if a load matches it before your availability window ends. Higher grades get priority matching, and matching also weighs market rates.

### Can I post more than one truck on Amazon Relay?
Yes. You can create several orders for different trucks and lanes. Use linked orders when one truck is posted on more than one order, so unfulfilled trips are cancelled once one fills.

### Does Post A Truck work for power only?
Yes. Amazon lists power only loads as eligible. Choose round trip if you don't have your own trailer, because one-way loads need a box truck or your own trailer.

# What happens if you cancel a load on Amazon Relay?

URL: https://nudoiq.com/amazon-relay-cancel-load/
Published: 2026-10-08. Last updated: 2026-10-08.

Short answer: Cancelling (rejecting) a load you booked on Amazon Relay counts against your acceptance metric, and so does letting a booked load expire. Amazon says the closer to pickup you reject, the higher the penalty. Your overall score equals your lowest metric, so a weak acceptance score can lower your grade. Loads that Amazon cancels don't count against you.

## What counts as a cancellation on Amazon Relay?

Amazon calls it a rejection. Its [performance score guide](https://relay.amazon.com/blog/amazon-relay-performance-score) defines the acceptance metric as "How often a carrier rejects loads that they book." Amazon's [grades page](https://relay.amazon.com/blog/intro-to-amazon-relay/relay-performance-grades-how-to-unlock-hauling-opportunities) says the same thing in other words: booking and completing loads without rejections, meaning carrier cancellations.

Two things count:

- **Rejecting a load you booked.** Any time you give a tendered load back, your score can take a hit.
- **Letting a booked load expire.** Amazon says this counts too. Doing nothing isn't a way out.

Amazon is plain about who owns a booking: "if an Amazon load is booked, it's the Relay carrier's responsibility to execute it."

## Does it matter when you cancel?

Yes, a lot. Amazon says: "The closer a carrier rejects to pick-up time, the higher the penalty."

The practical rule is simple. The moment you know a load won't work, release it. A cancellation two days out costs less than the same cancellation two hours out. Amazon doesn't publish how much less, but it does say the penalty rises as pickup gets closer.

## What if Amazon cancels the load?

Then it doesn't count against you. Amazon says that if it cancels tendered loads, the carrier's performance score won't be impacted.

You also don't lose the time completely. Amazon's [load board guide](https://relay.amazon.com/blog/how-to-use-amazon-relays-load-board) says the board suggests replacements for cancelled loads. Check the pickup window, deadhead and your driver's hours before you take one.

## How does one cancellation affect your whole grade?

Your overall score equals your lowest metric. Amazon scores four: on-time, acceptance, app usage and disruption-free. If acceptance is your weakest, it sets your grade, even with a perfect on-time record.

You become eligible for a grade after ten or more Relay loads in the last six active weeks. Our [scorecard guide](https://nudoiq.com/amazon-relay-scorecard/) breaks down all four metrics.

## What does a lower grade cost you?

Access. Here's what Amazon says each grade level gets you:

| Grade | What Amazon ties to it |
|---|---|
| All grades | Load board access, Relay Rewards eligibility, Post A Truck (higher grades get priority matching) |
| C+ and up | Most freight auctions (B for reefer, B+ for some box truck loads) |
| B and up | Seeing and booking new contracts |
| A+, A and B+ | Early access to new spot loads |
| A+ and A | Contract price alerts |
| Below C+ | Contracts you already booked are at risk |

Relay Rewards uses your lowest score too. Amazon evaluates your tier monthly, using your company's lowest score from the previous month. So a bad stretch on acceptance can reach past this week's loads into contracts, auctions and rewards. Our guides to [Amazon Relay contracts](https://nudoiq.com/amazon-relay-contracts/) and [auctions](https://nudoiq.com/amazon-relay-auctions/) explain what's on the line in each.

## How do you avoid having to cancel?

Amazon's own advice is to be selective when you browse the load board, so you don't book loads you can't haul. In practice:

1. **Do the hours math before you book.** First load, deadhead and second load against your driver's remaining hours. Our guide to [booking multiple loads](https://nudoiq.com/how-to-book-multiple-loads-on-amazon-relay/) has a checklist.
2. **Check the pickup window, not just the price.** Can your driver make it with room to spare?
3. **Use linked orders in Post A Truck.** If one truck is posted on several orders, linking them means unfulfilled trips are cancelled for you once one fills. See [how to post a truck on Amazon Relay](https://nudoiq.com/amazon-relay-post-a-truck/).
4. **Keep your Post A Truck availability current.** Cancel an order the moment plans change, before it matches a load.
5. **Release early when you must.** The penalty rises as pickup gets closer.

## What doesn't Amazon publish about cancellations?

More than most carriers expect. Amazon doesn't publish:

- **Cancellation fees.** The [Relay FAQ](https://relay.amazon.com/faq) says nothing about cancellation fees, or about pay when a truck order isn't used.
- **The size of the penalty** for a single rejection.
- **How long one cancellation stays** on your score. Amazon says the score reflects your last six weeks of hauls.
- **The score cutoffs** for each letter grade.
- **A dispute route for acceptance.** Amazon's dispute language on the performance score page covers on-time impacts only. It doesn't describe a way to dispute an acceptance hit.

If someone quotes you exact numbers for any of these, ask where they got them.

## Where does NudoIQ fit?

NudoIQ is a Chrome extension that runs inside your signed-in Relay load board tab. It's an independent tool, not made by or affiliated with Amazon. It doesn't change how Amazon scores a rejection. What it does is let you set rules up front about which loads get booked at all.

In Autobook mode it's set to book only loads that clear rules you set:

- **Min Net Profit.** It books only loads that clear your own minimum net profit.
- **Max stops.** Loads with more stops than your limit are skipped.
- **Complete data.** It never books a load with incomplete data.
- **Pickup lead time.** With a minimum lead time set, it won't book a load whose pickup time is unknown.
- **Max-books cap.** It stops after the number of bookings you set.

If you'd rather decide every load yourself, Alert mode tells you about a match without booking it. More in our [auto-booker guide](https://nudoiq.com/amazon-relay-auto-booker/).

Try it with a 7-day free trial, and cancel anytime. NudoIQ is rated 5.0 on the Chrome Web Store.

## Frequently asked questions

### Does rejecting a load on Amazon Relay hurt your score?
Yes. Rejecting a load you booked counts against your acceptance metric, and the closer to pickup you reject, the higher the penalty. Because your overall score is your lowest metric, acceptance can set your whole grade.

### Is there a fee for cancelling an Amazon Relay load?
Amazon doesn't publish one. The Relay FAQ says nothing about cancellation fees. The cost Amazon does describe is to your performance score.

### What happens if Amazon cancels my Relay load?
Your score isn't affected. Amazon says carrier scores aren't impacted when it cancels tendered loads, and the load board suggests replacements for cancelled loads.

### Does letting a load expire count as a rejection on Amazon Relay?
Yes. Amazon says a performance score can take a hit any time a carrier rejects tendered loads, including letting loads expire.

### Can I dispute an acceptance hit on my Relay scorecard?
Amazon doesn't publish a dispute route for acceptance. Its dispute language covers on-time impacts. For account-access problems, Amazon's FAQ points to the Support Center when you're logged in. The 24/7 Relay Operations Center handles operational support through the Relay portal or Relay mobile.

### How long does a cancellation stay on my Amazon Relay score?
Amazon doesn't say how long a single cancellation stays. It says your score reflects your last six weeks of hauls.

# Can you use a cargo van for Amazon Relay?

URL: https://nudoiq.com/amazon-relay-cargo-van/
Published: 2026-10-08. Last updated: 2026-10-08.

Short answer: No. Amazon's truck requirements page says "Cargo vans cannot be used for loads on Amazon Relay." The smallest equipment Amazon supports is a 16 ft dock-height box truck with a working tuck-under liftgate. Sprinter vans, pickup trucks and hotshot rigs aren't on Amazon's supported equipment list either.

## What does Amazon say about cargo vans on Relay?

Amazon says it in one line on its [truck requirements page](https://relay.amazon.com/blog/amazon-relay-truck-requirements): "Cargo vans cannot be used for loads on Amazon Relay." The [Relay FAQ](https://relay.amazon.com/faq) lists the same equipment and no vans.

So there's no van category to apply under, and no van loads to book. It doesn't matter how big the van is or how much it can carry. If it's a cargo van, it's out.

## What equipment does Amazon Relay accept?

This is Amazon's full supported list:

- **Tractors:** day cabs (short-distance) and sleeper cabs (long haul).
- **Box trucks:** 26 ft and 16 ft, dock height (also called straight trucks), with a functional tuck-under liftgate.
- **Trailers:** 48 ft trailers, 53 ft dry vans and 53 ft reefers. Reefers must meet the FDA Sanitary Transportation Rule.
- **Containers:** 20, 40 and 45 ft high cube, UIIA compliant, for drayage from rail and sea ports.

Two more things from the same page. Most Relay loads are power only: you bring the tractor and Relay supplies the trailer. And there's no fleet size requirement, so one truck can be enough.

## Can you use a sprinter van, pickup or hotshot for Amazon Relay?

Not on the list. Amazon's page doesn't name sprinter vans, pickup trucks or hotshot rigs at all. It lists what's supported, and none of them are on it.

So if you run a hotshot or a pickup today, that rig isn't on the list Amazon supports. Plan around equipment that is.

## What does FMCSA data show about trucks hauling Amazon freight?

In roadside inspections, big trucks carry almost all of it. We counted public FMCSA roadside inspections that list Amazon as the shipper, from 2023-09-24 to 2026-09-22. Of the 100,499 inspection rows with a vehicle weight class:

| Vehicle weight class | Share of Amazon-shipper rows |
|---|---|
| Over 54,000 lb (tractor-trailer) | 87.7% |
| 33,001 to 54,000 lb | 2.5% |
| 19,501 to 26,000 lb (box truck) | 7.4% |
| 14,001 to 19,500 lb | 0.7% |
| 10,001 to 14,000 lb | 0.1% |
| 10,000 lb or less | 0.0% |

At the carrier level, among carriers inspected with Amazon freight since 2025-01-01: tractor-trailer 83.9%, box truck 13.3%, step van 0.3%, and van 14,000 lb or less 0.1%.

Two caveats. An inspection is not a load: most loads are never inspected, so these counts are a floor. And Amazon on the bill of lading means Amazon freight, not proof of a Relay booking. It includes Amazon's own fleets and contract carriers. The full method is on our [Amazon Relay carrier data page](https://nudoiq.com/amazon-relay-carrier-data/).

## If you own a cargo van, what are your options for Relay?

Three paths exist, and each one starts with supported equipment.

### Run a box truck

A 16 ft or 26 ft dock-height box truck with a working tuck-under liftgate is the smallest way in. Box trucks can book spot loads, one-way loads and contracts, including 8-hour and 13-hour solo contracts with round trips. Our [Amazon Relay box truck guide](https://nudoiq.com/amazon-relay-box-truck/) covers the truck, and [how Amazon Relay contracts work](https://nudoiq.com/amazon-relay-contracts/) covers booking weeks of work ahead.

### Rent the equipment

Amazon says "Discounts are available for renting box trucks and tractors for a load." The terms are on [Amazon's discounts page](https://relay.amazon.com/discounts), so check them there before you plan around a rental.

### Go power only with a tractor

Most Relay loads are power only. A day cab or sleeper tractor hooks to an Amazon trailer, so you don't need to own a trailer for most of the work. Read [how Amazon Relay power only works](https://nudoiq.com/amazon-relay-power-only/).

## What else do you need besides the right truck?

The equipment is only one gate. The carrier account has its own rules, and they're the same whatever truck you run:

- A DOT number with interstate authority, active for at least 180 days, and a valid MC number.
- An FMCSA safety rating of Satisfactory, None or Not Rated.
- Insurance, including $1,000,000 auto liability per occurrence and at least $100,000 cargo.
- Verification of the business and every beneficial owner (anyone with more than 25%).

The full checklist is in our [Amazon Relay requirements guide](https://nudoiq.com/amazon-relay-requirements/), with coverages in the [insurance requirements guide](https://nudoiq.com/amazon-relay-insurance-requirements/).

## Where does NudoIQ fit?

Straight answer: NudoIQ can't help a cargo van get on Relay. There are no Relay loads for vans, so there's nothing for it to find.

Once you run supported equipment and have an approved Relay account, it's useful on the board. NudoIQ is a Chrome extension that runs inside your signed-in Relay load board tab. It refreshes the board on a 1 to 5 second interval, alerts you on box truck or power only loads that match your rules, and shows net profit on every load card after driver pay, fuel, maintenance and deadhead. It's an independent tool, not made by or affiliated with Amazon.

When you're ready, try it with a 7-day free trial, and cancel anytime. NudoIQ is rated 5.0 on the Chrome Web Store.

## Frequently asked questions

### Can you use a sprinter van for Amazon Relay?
No. Sprinter vans aren't on Amazon's supported equipment list, and Amazon says cargo vans can't be used for Relay loads. The smallest supported truck is a 16 ft dock-height box truck with a working tuck-under liftgate.

### Can you use a pickup truck for Amazon Relay?
Pickup trucks aren't on Amazon's supported equipment list. What Relay lists is day cab and sleeper tractors, 16 ft and 26 ft dock-height box trucks with a tuck-under liftgate, trailers and high cube containers.

### Can you do Amazon Relay with a hotshot?
Hotshot rigs aren't on Amazon's supported equipment list, so plan on a tractor or a box truck instead. Most Relay loads are power only, which means a day cab or sleeper tractor pulling an Amazon trailer.

### Is there an Amazon Relay load board for cargo vans?
No. Because Amazon says cargo vans can't be used on Relay, there are no van loads on the board. The smallest equipment that gets you onto the board is a 16 ft dock-height box truck with a working tuck-under liftgate.

### What is the smallest truck you can use for Amazon Relay?
A 16 ft box truck. It has to be dock height with a functional tuck-under liftgate. A 26 ft box truck with the same features also qualifies.

### Does Amazon help with renting a truck for Relay?
Amazon says discounts are available for renting box trucks and tractors for a load. The terms are on its discounts page at relay.amazon.com/discounts.

# Why does the Chrome Web Store show fewer users for NudoIQ than 300+ carriers?

URL: https://nudoiq.com/chrome-web-store-user-count/
Published: 2026-10-08. Last updated: 2026-10-08.

Short answer: The Chrome Web Store only counts people who installed NudoIQ from its store listing, which was created on May 21, 2026. Before that, NudoIQ was distributed directly to carriers, without the store, so those carriers are not in the store's number. In total, NudoIQ is used by 300+ carriers.

## How carriers got NudoIQ before the store

NudoIQ did not start on the Chrome Web Store. Caleb, who built it, distributed it directly to carriers on Amazon Relay, without the store.

NudoIQ was only recently turned into a Chrome Web Store extension. The store listing was created on May 21, 2026. Carriers who were already using NudoIQ before that date got it outside the store.

## What the store number counts

Google says the user count on a Chrome Web Store listing reflects users of that store item, meaning installs from that listing.

So the number on NudoIQ's listing only covers carriers who installed it through the store. It does not include the carriers who got NudoIQ directly. That is why the user count on the store listing is smaller than the 300+ carriers who use NudoIQ.

Nothing is hidden here. These are two different counts: one from the store, one from everyone using NudoIQ.

## How to check it yourself

Open the [NudoIQ listing on the Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/nudoiq/bjilnjgfdndecmamphkkcpplfmniocgk). You will see the user count and the rating. NudoIQ is rated 5.0 on the Chrome Web Store.

The most useful check is your own board. NudoIQ's free preview starts on install, and the 7-day free trial (no card needed to start) opens every feature. After that it is $49.99 a month, and you can cancel anytime. See [pricing](https://nudoiq.com/#pricing).

To see how NudoIQ compares with other Relay extensions, read [why carriers choose NudoIQ](https://nudoiq.com/why-nudoiq/).

NudoIQ is independent and not affiliated with Amazon.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is the 300+ carriers number real?
Yes. NudoIQ is used by 300+ carriers. Carriers who got NudoIQ directly, before the Chrome Web Store listing existed, are not in the store's count.

### When did NudoIQ go on the Chrome Web Store?
The store listing was created on May 21, 2026. Before that, NudoIQ was distributed directly to carriers.

### Does the Chrome Web Store count every NudoIQ user?
No. Google says the user count reflects users of the store item, so it only covers installs made from that listing.

### What is NudoIQ's rating on the Chrome Web Store?
NudoIQ is rated 5.0 on the Chrome Web Store. You can see the rating and the user count on the store listing.

# Why do carriers choose NudoIQ over other Amazon Relay extensions?

URL: https://nudoiq.com/why-nudoiq/
Published: 2026-10-08. Last updated: 2026-10-08.

Short answer: NudoIQ is the only Amazon Relay extension that books loads to your own minimum net profit and drafts scorecard dispute letters (checked October 5, 2026, across 52 other Relay listings on the Chrome Web Store). It is also the only extension in our side-by-side that lists all six core features, from auto-book to Telegram alerts. Every feature costs one flat $49.99 a month, the same for one truck or twenty.

## Why carriers choose NudoIQ

- AutoBook books only loads that clear your own Min Net Profit, and skips a load it cannot fully price.
- Every load card shows net profit and net $/mile after driver pay, fuel, maintenance and deadhead to pickup.
- NudoIQ drafts scorecard dispute letters from the violation. You review and submit the letter. Amazon decides.
- Lane Intelligence shows 90 days of a lane's prices, a target rate, an expected range and a confidence level. It is decision support, not a promise of a rate.
- The refresher runs every 1 to 5 seconds with jitter, in Alert, Search or AutoBook mode, with a profit floor and a max-books cap.
- One flat price: $49.99 a month for every feature, the same for one truck or twenty. 7-day free trial, no card needed to start.
- The interface is in English and Spanish.
- It runs in your own signed-in Relay tab and never asks for your Amazon password.

NudoIQ also includes Instant Book, Telegram alerts, a backhaul finder and one-click Post A Truck with a recommended bid. The recommended bid improves with use, so it is not accurate right after install.

A free preview starts on install: refresh, alerts, the NudoIQ bar and Lane Intelligence on the first 5 priced loads a day. AutoBook, Instant Book and dispute letters come with the 7-day free trial.

NudoIQ is rated 5.0 on the Chrome Web Store and used by 300+ carriers.

## NudoIQ compared with six other Relay extensions

| Feature | NudoIQ | LoadFetcher | Rocket Pro | Cardamon | RGD | SwiftRelay | EasyRelay |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Auto-book | Yes, to your minimum net profit | Advertised on its website, not on its store listing | Yes | Yes, with payout and $/mile floors | Yes | Yes | Not listed (fast book) |
| Books against net profit after your own costs | Yes | Not listed | Not listed | Not listed | Not listed | Not listed | Not listed |
| Net profit per load shown | Yes, after driver pay, fuel, maintenance and deadhead | Partial (financials and driver earnings, Plus plan) | Not listed | Not listed | Not listed | Not listed | Partial (tolls and deadhead shown) |
| Scorecard dispute letters | Yes | Not listed | Not listed | Not listed | Not listed | Not listed | Not listed |
| Lane price history | Yes, 90 days with target rate | Yes (load pricing and history) | Not listed | Comparison baseline only | Not listed | Live load stats | Per-trip gross per mile |
| Telegram alerts | Yes | Yes (Plus plan) | Sounds only | Sounds and alarms | Via sister app LODA | Not verified | Yes |
| Free trial | 7 days, no card | Free plan | 7 days | 7 days | 7 days, no card | 7 days | 7 days |

Read the first six rows. NudoIQ is the only extension of the seven with a Yes on every one: auto-book, booking to net profit, net profit per load, scorecard dispute letters, lane price history and Telegram alerts.

## What only NudoIQ does

On October 5, 2026, we checked 52 other Amazon Relay listings on the Chrome Web Store. Two features are on NudoIQ and on none of them:

1. **Scorecard dispute letters.** No other Relay listing offers them. NudoIQ drafts the letter from the violation, you submit it, and Amazon makes the call.
2. **AutoBook gated by net profit after your own costs.** Other extensions filter by payout, $/mile, stops or deadhead. None of them books to a net number. NudoIQ books a load only when what you keep, after driver pay, fuel, maintenance and deadhead, clears the floor you set.

## What other extensions list that NudoIQ doesn't

- **Booking on a free plan.** Rocket Pro's free tier lists FastBook on matches. NudoIQ's free preview covers refresh, alerts and lane prices; booking comes with the 7-day free trial, then $49.99 a month.
- **Multi-load booking.** RGD and SwiftRelay list booking more than one load at a time. NudoIQ does not.
- **Trip and driver tracking.** LoadFetcher and EasyRelay offer trip and driver tracking. NudoIQ does not.
- **Annual plan.** NudoIQ has no annual plan. It is month to month.

## Who NudoIQ fits, and who it doesn't

**NudoIQ fits you if** you want AutoBook to take only loads that clear your own net number, you want to see what a load nets before you take it, you deal with scorecard violations, or you run more than one truck and want one flat price.

**Another tool fits you better if** you want to book loads on a free plan, you want to book several loads in one click, or you need trip and driver tracking in the same tool.

For what to look for in any Relay extension, read the [guide to Amazon Relay extensions](https://nudoiq.com/best-amazon-relay-extensions/). Coming from LoadFetcher? See the [LoadFetcher alternative](https://nudoiq.com/loadfetcher-alternative/) page. To start the 7-day free trial, see [pricing](https://nudoiq.com/#pricing).

NudoIQ is independent and not affiliated with Amazon.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is NudoIQ the best Amazon Relay extension?
Judge it on the facts. NudoIQ is the only Amazon Relay extension that books to your own minimum net profit and drafts scorecard dispute letters, and the only one in our side-by-side that lists all six core features (checked October 5, 2026). If booking on a free plan or multi-load booking matters most, Rocket Pro lists FastBook on its free tier, and RGD and SwiftRelay list multi-load booking.

### Does NudoIQ have a free version?
Yes. A free preview starts on install: refresh, alerts, the NudoIQ bar and Lane Intelligence on the first 5 priced loads a day. AutoBook, Instant Book and dispute letters come with the 7-day free trial, no card needed to start, then $49.99 a month.

### How much does NudoIQ cost?
$49.99 a month for every feature, the same for one truck or twenty. There is no annual plan, and you can cancel anytime.

### Does NudoIQ work in Spanish?
Yes. The NudoIQ interface is in English and Spanish.

### Is NudoIQ affiliated with Amazon?
No. NudoIQ is an independent extension and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Amazon. It runs in your own signed-in Relay tab and never asks for your Amazon password.

# Rocket Relay alternative: NudoIQ vs Rocket Pro for the Amazon Relay load board

URL: https://nudoiq.com/rocket-relay-alternative/
Published: 2026-10-10. Last updated: 2026-10-10.

Short answer: If you want loads booked by net profit, after your own costs, NudoIQ is a good Rocket Relay alternative. Its AutoBook takes a load only if it clears your minimum net profit. Rocket Relay lists many filters, but no place to enter fuel or driver pay. 7 days free with no card, then $49.99 a month flat, every truck.

## What is a good Rocket Relay alternative?

NudoIQ, if you want loads booked by net profit, after your own costs. Rocket Relay's pages say its Pro plan auto books by payout, price per mile and more filters. NudoIQ [refreshes the board and books the loads that clear your number](https://nudoiq.com/amazon-relay-auto-refresh/).

To see how NudoIQ compares with Rocket Relay and five other Relay extensions on auto-booking, alerts and price, read [the full comparison](https://nudoiq.com/why-nudoiq/).

## What is Rocket Relay?

Rocket Relay is a browser extension for the Amazon Relay load board, from West Wanted. Its store listing is called Relay Auto Booker Refresher Rocket Pro. As of October 9, 2026, its listing and site name Alert, Search and Auto-book modes and one-click FastBook. They also name filters, bulk Post-a-Truck, price-change alerts and custom sounds. It runs in Chrome, Edge and Brave, and on Android in Lemur or Quetta.

## Does Rocket Relay auto book loads?

Yes, Rocket Relay auto books loads on its Pro plan. As of October 9, 2026, its listing says Auto-book takes matching loads by your filters, best-paying first. It stops at the number you set and runs only after you press Start. [NudoIQ's AutoBook books for you](https://nudoiq.com/amazon-relay-auto-booker/) too, but only loads that clear your minimum net profit, after the costs you enter.

## What does NudoIQ do that Rocket Relay doesn't list?

Rocket Relay's listing and checked site pages didn't name these three: an AutoBook net profit floor, net profit per load and scorecard dispute letters.

- Net profit floor for AutoBook: it books only loads that clear your minimum. It skips any load it can't fully price and stops at your max-books cap.
- Net profit on every load: net dollars and $/mile next to the price. It uses the costs you enter, like fuel, MPG, driver pay and maintenance.
- [Scorecard dispute letters](https://nudoiq.com/amazon-relay-scorecard/): it drafts the letter from the violation. You read it, send it, and Amazon makes the call.
- Also: Lane Intelligence (90-day lane price range), backhaul search, alerts or AutoBook on short-term contract offers, and Telegram alerts to your phone.

## What does Rocket Relay do that NudoIQ doesn't?

As of October 9, 2026, Rocket Relay's own pages list these, and NudoIQ doesn't have them.

- A Free plan you can stay on, with FastBook on matched trips and no card required. NudoIQ's free preview also refreshes and alerts, but it has no booking and ends when you start the trial.
- More booking rules (Pro): location by state, ZIP or facility, distance, stops, deadhead, stem time and time windows. It can watch several lanes at once.
- Bulk Post-a-Truck (Pro): modify, clone or delete many orders at once and assign drivers. Pro also puts FastBook on every trip.
- More languages for your board: its listing names 10, from German to Ukrainian.
- Local data: its listing says your loads, trips, payouts and drivers stay on your computer. NudoIQ keeps your driver list on a trial or paid plan, and any Fleet Dashboard trips, on its servers ([privacy policy](https://nudoiq.com/privacy.html)).
- Also listed: a ~ key to start and stop and your own alert sounds (Free). Pro adds auto-expanded trip stops, trailer-status badges and a filter for loads at Amazon locations only.

## How much does Rocket Relay cost vs NudoIQ?

On Rocket Relay, you pick a Free plan or Pro at $49 a month (checked October 9, 2026). Its 7-day Pro trial takes a card, but you aren't charged during it. NudoIQ starts with a free preview on install, then a 7-day free trial with no card needed. After that it's $49.99 a month flat for every truck. Cancel anytime.

## Should you pick Rocket Relay or NudoIQ?

### Pick Rocket Relay if

- You want to stay on a free plan. Its Free plan has auto-refresh, alerts and FastBook on matched trips.
- You want auto booking by location, distance, stops or time windows, or on several lanes at once.
- You post many trucks and want to change Post-a-Truck orders in bulk.
- You want your load data kept on your own computer, or need a language beyond English and Spanish.

### Pick NudoIQ if

- You want loads booked only when they clear your minimum net profit, after your own costs.
- You want to see what each load nets you, and what its lane has paid, before you take it.
- You fight scorecard hits and want the dispute letter drafted for you.
- You want 7 days of auto booking with no card, or Telegram load alerts on your phone.

Not sure which is right for your board? Try NudoIQ 7 days free. If it doesn't fit how you book, switch back. It costs you a week, not a dime.

[Try NudoIQ 7 days free](https://nudoiq.com/get/)

## How do you switch from Rocket Relay to NudoIQ?

Turn off or remove Rocket Relay in your Chrome extensions. Add NudoIQ from the Chrome Web Store, [open the Relay load board](https://nudoiq.com/amazon-relay-load-board/) and press START. Your Relay login doesn't change. Paying for Rocket Pro? Its site says you cancel in the Stripe customer portal.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is Rocket Relay?
Rocket Relay is a browser extension for the Amazon Relay load board, published by West Wanted. Its listing and site name Alert, Search and Auto-book modes, one-click FastBook, filters and bulk Post-a-Truck (checked October 9, 2026). It has a Free plan and a $49 Pro plan. NudoIQ is a separate extension for the same board, with AutoBook at your minimum net profit.

### Is Rocket Relay a Chrome extension?
Yes, Rocket Relay is a browser extension you add from the Chrome Web Store. Its listing names Chrome, Edge and Brave on desktop, plus Android browsers such as Lemur and Quetta (checked October 9, 2026). NudoIQ is a separate Chrome extension that also works on Android in browsers such as Lemur. Run one load board extension at a time so the two don't conflict.

### Is Rocket Relay free?
Yes, Rocket Relay has a Free plan with auto-refresh, new-trip alerts and FastBook on matched trips. No card is required. Search, Auto-book, the filters and Post-a-Truck are on Pro, at $49 a month (checked October 9, 2026). NudoIQ has no free plan. It has a free preview with refresh and alerts, then a 7-day free trial with no card needed.

### Does Rocket Relay have a free trial?
Yes, Rocket Relay's Pro plan starts with a 7-day free trial. Its FAQ says you add a card to begin but aren't charged during the trial (checked October 9, 2026). Its Free plan needs no card. NudoIQ's 7-day free trial needs only an email, no card. AutoBook, Instant Book and dispute letters come with it.

### How much does Rocket Relay cost compared to NudoIQ?
Rocket Relay Pro costs $49 a month plus any sales tax. Its Free plan costs nothing (checked October 9, 2026). NudoIQ is one $49.99 plan, the same price for one truck or a whole fleet, with a 7-day free trial and cancel anytime.

### Does Rocket Relay auto book loads?
Yes, Rocket Relay auto books loads on its Pro plan. Its listing says Auto-book takes matching loads by your filters, best-paying first, up to the number you set (checked October 9, 2026). It books only after you press Start. NudoIQ's AutoBook books only loads that clear your own minimum net profit, after the costs you enter.

### Is Rocket Relay a refresher or an auto booker?
Rocket Relay is both a load board refresher and an auto booker. Auto-refresh and new-trip alerts are in its Free plan, and Auto-book is on Pro, $49 a month (checked October 9, 2026). NudoIQ refreshes the board too, and its AutoBook books by your minimum net profit, after the costs you enter.

### Is Rocket Pro the same as Rocket Relay?
Yes, Rocket Pro is the Rocket Relay extension for the Amazon Relay load board. Its Chrome Web Store listing is named Relay Auto Booker Refresher Rocket Pro for Amazon Relay. The listing shows version 9.0.2, updated July 30, 2026. Pro is also the name of its paid plan, $49 a month (checked October 9, 2026).

### What is Rocket Relay Post Truck Manager?
Rocket Relay Post Truck Manager is a separate Chrome Web Store listing for Post a Truck orders. Its developer is Tasiev LLC, not West Wanted. It lists bulk delete, move and duplicate, at $39.99 a month after a 7-day trial (checked October 9, 2026). NudoIQ has no bulk order tools. It has [One-Click Post A Truck](https://nudoiq.com/amazon-relay-post-a-truck/) from a load, with a recommended bid that improves with use.

### Is there a free Rocket Relay alternative?
NudoIQ's free preview, with refresh and alerts, runs until you start the 7-day free trial, which needs no card. After the trial, it's $49.99 a month to keep using it, so it isn't a free plan. If you want to stay on a free plan, Rocket Relay's own Free plan has auto-refresh and alerts. [EasyRelay](https://nudoiq.com/easyrelay-alternative/) lists a $0 Free plan, with its refresher on paid plans (checked October 9, 2026).

### Can I switch from Rocket Relay to NudoIQ?
Yes, you can switch in a few minutes. Turn off or remove Rocket Relay on Chrome's extensions page, add NudoIQ from the Chrome Web Store, and start the 7-day free trial. Your Relay login and load board stay the same. Run one load board extension at a time so the two don't conflict.

### Is NudoIQ or Rocket Relay made by Amazon?
No, neither is made by Amazon, and both run inside the Relay load board in your own Chrome. NudoIQ is independent software from Sami Enterprises LLC and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Amazon. Rocket Relay is published by West Wanted.

### Does NudoIQ work in Spanish?
Yes, NudoIQ works in English and Spanish, including the load board buttons and alerts. It runs on Amazon Relay in Spain too, plus the US, Canada and seven other countries. Rocket Relay's listing names Spanish too, among 10 languages (checked October 9, 2026).

### How does NudoIQ decide which loads to book?
In AutoBook mode, NudoIQ books only loads that clear your minimum net profit. If you set a minimum $/mile, they must clear that too. It never books a load it can't fully price, such as one missing a pickup time, miles or pay. It stops at your max-books cap. ALERT mode tells you about a match without booking it. That matters, because [cancelling a booked load counts against you](https://nudoiq.com/amazon-relay-cancel-load/).
